tasks.subject: Task 1: SwipeGestureLevel model
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Créer le modèle `SwipeGestureLevel` avec `SwipeDirection` et ses tests unitaires.

**Files:**
- Create: `EscapeFromBlindness/Models/SwipeGestureLevel.swift`
- Create: `EscapeFromBlindnessTests/Level Types/SwipeGestureLevelTests.swift`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `SwipeDirection` enum avec cases `.vertical` et `.horizontal`
- [ ] `SwipeGestureLevel` est une sous-classe de `Level`
- [ ] L'init accepte `instruction`, `swipeDirections`, `pages`, `validAnswer`, `hints`
- [ ] `validAnswers` hérité de `Level` est initialisé à `[validAnswer]`
- [ ] Les tests passent

```json:metadata
{"files": ["EscapeFromBlindness/Models/SwipeGestureLevel.swift", "EscapeFromBlindnessTests/Level Types/SwipeGestureLevelTests.swift"], "verifyCommand": "xcodebuild test -workspace EscapeFromBlindness.xcworkspace -scheme EscapeFromBlindness -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16e' -only-testing:EscapeFromBlindnessTests/SwipeGestureLevelTests", "acceptanceCriteria": ["SwipeDirection enum avec .vertical et .horizontal", "SwipeGestureLevel sous-classe de Level", "validAnswers initialisé à [validAnswer]", "Tests passent"]}
```
